svg.text: black basalt, grey ash slopes, a cone with a rim, a few cooled lava flows; the rocky highland in its cold state
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 21.2 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 21.1 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)
a pale-grey fused streak on black rock, the edge faintly warm-orange in a
a bowl in ash and clinker, the inside a lighter grey with a raised ring of
the few shrubs black; a fresh thin orange crust of cooling rock where the
fight went on (a static colour, never pulsing)

C. Destruction in volcanic highland: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). Ash and clinker: a dark grey column that rises slowly and spreads, black blocks on arcs, a few steady orange ember chips.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)
Black cliffs drop straight into the sea; sea stacks stand off the cliff; a thin
steam vent stands on the shore (grey facets).
Volcanic highland to Beach and coast

A black lava plain with sand drifted in streaks; basalt columns; the sand steps
The rock turns from grey to black, ash slopes replace scree, a cone stands
